name: shipwithai-fixkit
description: ShipWithAI Fixkit — a stack-agnostic, layer-aware bug-fix engine for Claude Code. Phase 0 ships the reusable core; platform adapters and the ShipWithAI pack arrive in later phases.

plugins.name: shipwithai-fixkit-core
plugins.description: Stack-agnostic, layer-aware bug-fix engine. Classify by symptom layer, debug on a vendored systematic-debugging spine, close only on layer-appropriate proof.

plugins.name: shipwithai-fixkit-web
plugins.description: Thin web adapter for the fixkit engine: maps ~~connectors to concrete web tooling (bundled headless Playwright runner, astro dev, node/vitest), ships per-layer reproduce/verify/source-map recipes plus generic Astro fix recipes, and closes UI bugs autonomously at FULL via the in-loop runner (6 measures onto the 5 UI LAYER_METHODS). No debugging logic — that lives in core.

plugins.name: shipwithai-fixkit-backend
plugins.description: Thin backend adapter for the fixkit engine: maps ~~connectors to concrete backend tooling (npm/vitest/jest/pytest, CI pipelines, log/monitoring boundaries) and ships per-layer reproduce/verify/source-map recipes for runnable server stacks. Logic/System = FULL, UI = NONE. No debugging logic — that lives in core.

plugins.name: shipwithai-fixkit-kmp
plugins.description: Thin Kotlin Multiplatform adapter for the fixkit engine: maps ~~connectors to JVM/Gradle tooling (./gradlew :shared:test, GitHub Actions) and ships per-layer reproduce/verify/source-map recipes. Shared commonMain Logic/System = FULL; platform UI = ASSIST (emits handoff/v0, ceiling candidate). No debugging logic — that lives in core.

plugins.name: shipwithai-fixkit-android
plugins.description: Thin Android adapter for the fixkit engine: maps ~~connectors to Gradle/JVM tooling (./gradlew testDebugUnitTest, GitHub Actions) and ships per-layer reproduce/verify/source-map recipes. App/business Logic + Gradle System = FULL; Compose/View UI = ASSIST (emits handoff/v0, ceiling candidate). No debugging logic — that lives in core.

plugins.name: shipwithai-fixkit-ios
plugins.description: Thin iOS adapter for the fixkit engine: maps ~~connectors to Xcode/Swift tooling (xcodebuild test / swift test on a macOS host, GitHub Actions) and ships per-layer reproduce/verify/source-map recipes. Host-runnable Logic + build System = FULL (macOS precondition); SwiftUI/UIKit UI = ASSIST (emits handoff/v0, ceiling candidate). No debugging logic — that lives in core.
